penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Meaningful Salesforce permission auditing requires authenticated access to each customer's Salesforce org via Connected App setup, which involves per-customer OAuth provisioning and configuration that cannot be fully automated by Claude alone.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce environments are highly customized; edge-case support questions about org-specific permission structures will require human judgment to resolve reliably.

rationale: Salesforce admins and RevOps professionals are real, identifiable buyers with demonstrated willingness to pay for tooling (Salesforce AppExchange apps routinely charge $50–200/month per org), and permission debugging is a known recurring time sink. However, actually auditing effective permissions requires Salesforce Connected App authentication per customer org — meaning per-customer OAuth setup and org-specific configuration that sits outside what Claude prompts and a simple landing page can deliver autonomously. The weighted total of 5.4 is borderline, but penalties drop it to 3.4 and multiple build gates are unmet.
solution_plan: The closest viable version for this factory would be a Claude-powered Salesforce Permission Troubleshooting Guide — a structured intake form where an admin describes their user's symptoms, and Claude produces a step-by-step checklist of likely permission issues and fixes, delivered as a PDF or email. This avoids the per-org API integration problem entirely. It could be sold as a one-time $29 'diagnostic report' via a Stripe payment link and a Typeform intake. However, the value would be modest (this is essentially a smart checklist), repeat purchase rates would be low, and it competes with free Salesforce community answers. If the operator wants to pursue this, it should be validated first by offering 5 manual reports to Salesforce admin communities (Salesforce Trailblazer, RevOps co-ops) before building automation.
notes: Failing build gates: operational_autonomy (5 < 7 required), buildability_with_ai (5 < 6 required — borderline, the Connected App OAuth integration is the blocking dependency). A Claude-only advisory product without org API access is buildable but of limited value.
